questions.title: Everyday situation 31
questions.statement: Read the situation: An exchange student is dealing with an everyday situation such as shopping, asking for information, making an appointment, ordering food, or solving a routine problem. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.label: A
options.text: The student should use the available information to complete the task appropriately.

options.label: B
options.text: The student should ignore the situation completely.

options.label: C
options.text: The student must immediately leave the location.

options.label: D
options.text: The situation has no practical purpose.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A because the situation describes a normal daily-life task that requires understanding information and responding appropriately. Option B ignores the purpose of the interaction. Option C is unsupported by the scenario. Option D is incorrect because the situation clearly has a practical objective related to everyday communication.
